apps.name: Kumone
apps.subtitle: 原生 NetEase Cloud Music iOS 客户端（雲の音）
apps.localizedDescription:
Kumone（雲の音）— native NetEase Cloud Music client for iOS. Talks directly to NetEase's real API with no third-party server: QR-code login, gray-track unblocking, synced lyrics with translation, immersive artwork-tinted now-playing, and playlist management.

Supports English and Simplified Chinese localization.

versions.localizedDescription:
### Added / 新增

- **macOS**: a 「减少推荐」 (reduce recommendation) right-click action on un-liked songs in 每日推荐 and 私人雷达 lists — it asks NetEase to swap the song out and replaces it in place. Thanks @yamakze (#84, closes #74).
- **macOS**：每日推荐 / 私人雷达 列表里,未收藏歌曲的右键菜单新增「减少推荐」——会请求网易云替换该歌曲并就地替换。感谢 @yamakze（#84，关闭 #74）。

### Fixed / 修复

- **iOS**: the lock screen and Dynamic Island Now Playing controls show previous/next track again instead of back-15s/forward-15s. Registering the ±15s skip commands (added for CarPlay in 0.3.15) made iOS pick the podcast-style skip layout system-wide and hid the track buttons; those commands are removed, so previous/next are the media buttons everywhere (CarPlay included). (#83, #87)
- **iOS**：锁屏与灵动岛的「正在播放」控制重新显示上一首 / 下一首，而不是后退 15 秒 / 前进 15 秒。此前为 CarPlay 注册的 ±15 秒快进快退命令（0.3.15 引入）让 iOS 在全局采用了播客式布局、把切歌按钮挤掉了；现已移除这两个命令，上一首 / 下一首恢复为各处（含 CarPlay）的系统媒体按钮。（#83、#87）
- **macOS**: the search results page no longer shows a second, empty system search box on top of the toolbar search field — the page's `.searchable` bar is now iOS-only. Thanks @yamakze (#90, closes #89).
- **macOS**：搜索结果页不再在工具栏搜索框之外多出一个空的系统搜索框——结果页的 `.searchable` 搜索栏改为仅 iOS 使用。感谢 @yamakze（#90，关闭 #89）。

apps.name: MiniWatts
apps.subtitle: Battery, charging and thermal instrument for iPhone
apps.localizedDescription: A battery, charging and thermal instrument for iPhone, built on Apple's private power-management APIs. It shows what the charger is delivering, how much of it reaches the cell, where the rest goes as heat, and what the phone's temperature sensors are doing while it happens.

versions.localizedDescription:
## 新功能

- **悬浮读数可以自定义内容**：可以只显示充电功率、只显示部件温度，或两者都显示；温度可以四项一起显示（SoC、电池、充电器、最高温度），也可以只显示其中一项。两者都显示时，可以同屏排列，或每 4 秒轮流切换。画面底部会显示 iOS 系统发热状态。设置页里有实时预览。感谢 @EASU555（#5）。
- **实时活动可以选择主读数**：灵动岛紧凑状态可以显示充电功率、SoC 温度、电池温度或最高部件温度，在设置里选择。锁屏和展开的灵动岛会同时显示这四项读数。感谢 @EASU555（#6）。
- **实时活动加入"结束"按钮**：锁屏和展开的灵动岛上都有。MiniWatts 被挂起或被划掉时，也能直接把实时活动关掉。

## 修复

- 锁屏上的实时活动重新排版，不再因为内容过高被系统裁掉上下边距。
- 悬浮读数在没有充电时，不再把放电功率标成"充电功率"。
- 更正设置页的说明：只有在 MiniWatts 运行时拔下充电器，实时活动才会在两分钟后自动结束。

## 说明

- 实时活动只能由运行中的 MiniWatts 更新和结束。App 被挂起时拔下充电器，灵动岛会变灰、锁屏显示"已暂停"，直到下次打开 MiniWatts，或者点实时活动上的"结束"。
- 这个版本在 iPhone Air 上开发和验证。传感器的名称和换算因机型而异，其他机型可能有读数不准，欢迎带上机型标识反馈。

---

## New

- **Configurable floating meter**: show charging power, component temperatures, or both. Temperatures can be all four at once (SoC, battery, charger, hottest) or a single one. With both selected, lay them out side by side or alternate every four seconds. The bottom of the window shows iOS's system thermal state, and Settings has a live preview. Thanks to @EASU555 (#5).
- **Selectable Live Activity reading**: the compact Dynamic Island shows charging power, SoC temperature, battery temperature or the hottest component, chosen in Settings. The Lock Screen and the expanded island show all four together. Thanks to @EASU555 (#6).
- **End button on the Live Activity**, on the Lock Screen and in the expanded island. It closes the activity even while MiniWatts is suspended or has been swiped away.

## Fixes

- The Lock Screen activity is laid out to fit: it no longer runs taller than the space iOS gives it and loses its top and bottom padding.
- Off the charger, the floating meter no longer labels the discharge figure "Charging power".
- The Settings caption no longer promises the activity always ends two minutes after unplugging: that only happens while MiniWatts is running.

## Notes

- Only a running MiniWatts can update or end its Live Activity. Unplug while the app is suspended and the island greys out and the Lock Screen says paused, until you open MiniWatts again or tap End.
- Developed and checked on an iPhone Air. Sensor names and scaling differ between models, so other models may misread; reports with the model identifier are welcome.

apps.name: Opaline
apps.subtitle: YouTube client for iOS 12+
apps.localizedDescription: A lightweight, privacy-focused YouTube client for iOS, built with UIKit. SponsorBlock, Return YouTube Dislike, up to 1080p playback, background audio, Picture-in-Picture, subtitles and offline downloads — no ads, no tracking, no dependencies.

versions.localizedDescription:
**New**

- Hold anywhere on the video to seek ([#116](https://github.com/verback2308/Opaline/issues/116)). Press and hold on the picture, then drag sideways. The seek bar follows your finger and the video jumps where you let go, so you no longer have to hit the thin bar at the bottom. The taps you already know still work: the sides seek, the middle pauses.
- Search inside a channel ([#117](https://github.com/verback2308/Opaline/issues/117)). Channel pages have a magnifier now, and whatever you type there searches that channel only. YouTube serves no filters for this kind of search, so there are none in the app either.
- Get a downloaded video out of the app ([#115](https://github.com/verback2308/Opaline/issues/115)). The menu on a downloaded video has a new "Save to Files" row that hands the file to the usual iOS share sheet, so it can go to Files, Photos, AirDrop or another app. It is named after the video, and only the video leaves: subtitles, comments and the saved page stay where they were.
- Clear the whole search history at once ([#121](https://github.com/verback2308/Opaline/issues/121)). The last row under Recent searches wipes the list, and it asks first.

**Fixes**

- The mini player no longer sits on top of the tab bar ([#118](https://github.com/verback2308/Opaline/issues/118)). Tapping a tab behind the collapsed player switches to that tab instead of reopening the video.
- Stereo no longer gets spatialized on AirPods ([#119](https://github.com/verback2308/Opaline/issues/119)). Ordinary two-channel sound was being turned into a fake surround field that moved when you turned your head. Video that really is multichannel still spatializes.
- The "..." menu stops closing on its own ([#128](https://github.com/verback2308/Opaline/issues/128)). It was reacting to the device being tilted or put down, which made it look random when you held the phone in your hand.

**Also**

- If your device is older than Opaline supports, the README now points at [a downport for iOS 9](https://github.com/Joeviocoe/Opaline) by another developer, which runs on the iPad 2, iPad 3, iPad mini and iPhone 4S ([#125](https://github.com/verback2308/Opaline/issues/125)).

apps.name: Pocket Poster
apps.subtitle: Custom PosterBoard animated wallpapers for iOS 17.0+
apps.localizedDescription: Custom PosterBoard animated wallpapers for iOS 17.0+. Browse community wallpapers in the built-in explore page, import your own videos and images, and apply them as animated posters — including CarPlay and per-collection sets.

versions.localizedDescription:
# Features
- Added an in-app explore page for finding and downloading wallpapers
- Added custom CarPlay wallpapers (will not work on iOS 26.0)
- *Preliminary* iOS 16 support (not all wallpapers will work)
- Improved certain error messages

# Bug Fixes
- Fixed the aspect ratio/rotation of imported custom videos
- Fixed the update API not being called correctly
- Fixed issues with some alerts not popping up
- Other various app stability improvements
